issue: CNI highly skewed by pagecaches [closed; labels area/perf and scalability]
Version: 1.24
Platform: EKS, **cgroupv1** Amazon Linux 2

I noticed some behavior where CNI is using a large amount of memory. I've seen this many times in the past without investigating it as well. K8s reports ~100mb usage, but Go says its heap is only 5mb.

I did some investigation and found a bit of info

![2024-10-09_16-11-27](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/32e51e1d-3033-4685-b30f-82e4a3fc4a50)

Above shows a CNI pod memory usage. The spike is me running /debug/pprof/heap (why does this cause a

spike?? no clue, but its reproducible!)

The drop is after running `echo 1 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches`.

This seems to me a fairly known issue: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/43916. There is some suggestions cgroupv2 is not impacted.

Unclear if we can do anything about it. drop_caches is bad since its the entire node, not container scoped.

Easy reproducer:

```
$ cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.stat | grep ^active_file
active_file 53403648
$ stat -c %s /host/opt/cni/bin/istio-cni
52166808
$ echo …
